source_claim: AlphaEvolve mixes a fast model for high-volume breadth with a stronger model for occasional deeper suggestions under a fixed compute budget
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve has a throughput_depth strategy with backend cost, latency, and depth metadata, min/max normalization, metadata weights, neutral missing-metadata defaults, backend role/model-lane labels, fast-breadth and strong-depth lane detection, eligible-backend lane traces, per-call scheduler policy records, and explicit false claim-readiness lane evidence. It does not claim experiment-level selection traces, fixed compute budget definition, matched problem/seed/evaluator identity, fast/strong provider-model identity, lane quota schedule, per-lane token/cost/latency accounting, lane switching traces, breadth-volume attribution, breakthrough-quality attribution, reserved fast-breadth lane policy, reserved strong-depth lane policy, candidate throughput outcomes, candidate quality/depth outcomes, equal-budget single-model comparison, or equal-budget generic-UCB comparison.
